Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 55% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 30%, 50% and 68% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries sapphire crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING SAPPHIRE BLUE crystal points, VIVID SILVER mineral veins. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, hannya mask formations in CRIMSON and STARK GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries living peony blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING CRIMSON blossoms, VIVID EMERALD leaves and tendrils. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
